snippet.title: PROJECT TITAN- The Redacted Files- 4K gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4106800/Project_Titan_The_Redacted_Files/?beta=0



If I were to let the world die, would anyone care?”

Dive into a brutal 90s inspired cyberpunk world where every bullet counts and every secret could be your last.


Follow Trevor, a Special agent detective in the R.P.R.S as he explores Dynawatch, the metropolis rotting from the inside out. To uncover a conspiracy that threatens to erase humanity, you must explore treacherous, interconnected environments, solve devious puzzles, and manage scarce resources in tense, tactical combat.

The line between man and gods has blurred, creating horrific new threats. Fight for your life against TiTan corrupted HUSKs, mercenary squads, and deadly autonomous drones. Master a unique combat system that lets you seamlessly switch between classic tank controls and fluid 2D movement on the fly.

KEY FEATURES:

    HYBRID COMBAT SYSTEM: Switch instantly between classic survival-horror tank controls and dynamic 2D shooting. Master the system to survive the odds and dominate your enemies.

    BRUTAL RESOURCE MANAGEMENT: Ammo is scarce, health items are precious, and even your ability to save the game is a limited resource. Every decision carries weight.

    DEEP CYBERNOIR MYSTERY: Uncover the truth by reading logs, documents, and clues. Your discoveries unlock new areas, reveal side quests, and expose the dark narrative.

    SURVIVAL-ACTION EVOLVED: Inspired by the greats: face the tactical tension of Resident Evil, the scenic vibes of Parasite Eve, and the stylish tone of Devil May Cry.

    FACE THE INVASION: Battle a terrifying bestiary of enemies, from shambling HUSKs and elite mercenaries to robotic drones and screen-filling bosses.


Save the city. Save the world, but most importantly. SAVE HER.


Music for the trailer by @tilogo 
gameplay made by me, trailer art by me and edited by me.
sound effects from freesound.org and pixabay.
